name: InnoRenew CoE
zag_role: Partner institute, ZAG is a founding partner
description: Set up under the Horizon 2020 teaming action with ZAG among the partners. It works on renewable building materials and healthy indoor environments. Friderik Knez led ZAG's side of the project from 2017 to 2022.
history: InnoRenew CoE is at Livade 6a in Izola and works on renewable materials and sustainable building. Its two distinguishing fields are wood modification and restorative environmental and ergonomic design. A consortium of ten partners led by the University of Primorska submitted the proposal to Horizon 2020 in 2016, and ZAG was one of the core partners. The Horizon 2020 Teaming operation was valued at 14,996,025.00 euros including tax, with national co financing of about 39 million euros, giving a total of about 54 million euros. Since a court decision of 29 July 2025, InnoRenew CoE has been an independent department of the UP Andrej Marušič Institute at the University of Primorska. Over eight and a half years it had run 96 publicly funded projects worth 15.78 million euros together with industry projects worth 2.81 million euros.

source_differences: Record 'built: Established 15 February 2017' should be distinguished from the building opening, 15 Feb 2022 (FAMNIT).
Timber volume differs between sources: 1,100 m3 (NEB) vs 850 m3 in the timber section (FAMNIT).
Owner: the Open House Slovenia page names InnoRenew CoE as owner and investor. The cadastre lists Občina Izola as owner of the building and of the parcel.
Storeys: the Open House Slovenia page describes four levels, the cadastre gives 5 storeys, a count that includes storeys below ground.
